=== FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
- tests/test_workflow_failure_heal_queue.py:32, 39-41, 106-114 | severity=high | confidence=5
  PROBLEM: `test_position_cli` writes fixture ticket timestamps anchored to `NOW = datetime(2026, 10, 23, 12, 0, tzinfo=timezone.utc)` (line 32) via `_ticket(..., age_seconds=5)` (line 108), producing `created_at` of `2026-10-23T11:59:55Z`. The test then invokes the CLI via subprocess (line 113), which uses the real wall clock — not `NOW`. The default lease is 10,800 seconds (3 hours). When CI ran at 16:12 UTC (over 4 hours after the fixture timestamp), the CLI correctly classified the ticket as stale and returned `status: "go"`, but the test asserts `status: "wait"` (line 114).
  WHY: The unit-level `_position` helper (line 44-45) passes `now=NOW` so it is deterministic, but the CLI subprocess has no way to receive `NOW` and uses `datetime.now(timezone.utc)`. After 3 hours the fixture ticket expires and the assertion fails. This is a pre-existing test defect unrelated to this PR's change to `tests/e2e_smoke_canary.txt`.
=== END FINDINGS FROM qwen_qwen3_7-plus ===
